try: Open {url}. The sidebar groups chats under projects: "health insurance claim" (current, its three chats from v0.12) and "move flat" (two chats). The URL says ?project=health-insurance-claim. Click "flat search" under move flat: the board changes to that project's kanban (four tasks), the URL says ?project=move-flat; Back returns.

Under move flat press "+ new chat" and send "Task: order a new kitchen lamp." The card lands on move flat's board only; switch back to health insurance claim and it is not there. Click a project header to collapse or expand it.

Press "+ new project" (it puts /project new in the input), type a name, Enter: a new project with an empty board and its own rules.json in {dir}/<id>/; projects.json lists it. /projects lists them all; /project rename, /project archive (nothing is deleted).
Open {url}/?project=move-flat in a second tab: each tab stays in its project, and a card added in one project never shows in the other tab. Below 900 px the sidebar is a drawer (☰).
